title: 2934 implement mapping permissions
body:
Fixes #2934 

The functionality in here should be testable in the Storybook.

Note, these things can help you investigate things are working:
- the properties (including which ones are player-editable) are defined in this file, alongside the different sets of participation (e.g. `bluePlanningParticipant`) , which control which force can see which other force (and/or properties) in different phases: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/2949/files#diff-5994f11c70ad05180e7d3b35dfcfe3c58d9ec0a5720d004c993ce02899e2f579
- It's in the `Organism/CoreMapping` story.

BTW - this is what my Storybook looks like. The Args/Controls can be used to change the game-phase and which force we're playing as.
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/3bfcbf0b-0a70-4312-b72c-8d8045d05d5f)

issues.title: Use mapping permissions
issues.body:
We have a task to define how the permissions work for the mapping channel #2931 

We should now modify Serge mapping to adhere to those permissions.

This should include:
- whether the role can view the mapping tab
- whether the role can add new features for each renderer
- whether the role can move/resize features for each renderer
- whether the role can edit user-editable properties for own/other features
- whether the role can edit all properties for own/other features

Note: when we do this, we should extend the core mapping storyboard to allow us to quickly modify the current role and/or phase.
